hypothesis: For an executed core company position with at least 20 continuously reporting N-PORT fund series, split-adjusted aggregate shares increasing quarter over quarter merit 1.10x opening notional, decreasing shares 0.90x, and missing coverage 1.00x.
single_causal_variable: SEC N-PORT split-adjusted continuous-fund QoQ aggregate-share sign controls a fixed 1.10/0.90/1.00 opening-notional scalar.

parameters.split_low_sample_fallback: When a report-date cross-section has fewer than 20 implied-price observations, the locked split factor is 1.0 and the signal remains eligible.

frozen_split_price_union.same_date_consensus_rule: Require all source Closes equal within rel_tol=1e-6/abs_tol=1e-6, then use their arithmetic mean; never prefer a source.
frozen_split_price_union.lookup: last consensus frozen Close on or before N-PORT report_date
